# DeepBridge Advisory

> DeepBridge Advisory is a UK-based specialist advisory and delivery partner helping organisations build experienced independent teams for complex transformation programmes across the UK and Europe.

DeepBridge Advisory is the trading name of DUSTDEEP LTD, company number 16775578, registered in England and Wales. The registered office is Kemp House, 152-160 City Road, London, United Kingdom, EC1V 2NX.

## Core services

- [SAP and ERP transformation](https://www.deepbridgeadvisory.co.uk/expertise): independent specialists supporting SAP S/4HANA and enterprise resource planning programmes.
- [Supply chain transformation](https://www.deepbridgeadvisory.co.uk/expertise): specialist capability across planning, procurement, logistics, manufacturing and operating-model change.
- [Data and business intelligence](https://www.deepbridgeadvisory.co.uk/expertise): expertise spanning data strategy, governance, migration, analytics and business intelligence.
- [Programme leadership and delivery](https://www.deepbridgeadvisory.co.uk/expertise): experienced programme, workstream and change leadership for complex delivery.

## Who DeepBridge supports

- [For clients](https://www.deepbridgeadvisory.co.uk/for-clients): focused specialist search, transformation team build-out, contracting, onboarding and delivery coordination.
- [For independent consultants](https://www.deepbridgeadvisory.co.uk/for-consultants): relevant transformation opportunities across the UK and Europe.
- [About DeepBridge](https://www.deepbridgeadvisory.co.uk/about): company purpose, principles and cross-border approach.
